source_binding.mechanism: direct terminal checking paired with a relation-based metamorphic acceptance view; checker diversity is treated as a guard, not as proof of independence

public_sources.claim_used: Metamorphic testing addresses the oracle problem by checking relations among inputs and outputs of multiple related executions rather than relying only on a conventional direct oracle.

Empirical evaluation of multiversion programming found coincident failures substantially above what an independence assumption predicted, so superficial multiplicity cannot be treated as guaranteed independence.
Software design-diversity reliability gains depend on failure dependence; independence assumptions can be untenable and actual dependence is difficult to assess.

source_binding.literal_external_runtime_reason: No external test runner, cloud testing service, hosted model, or multiversion execution platform is used. Public sources supply only the oracle-diversity and correlation semantics.
source_binding.chat_native_reduction: Q1 is a direct same-scope terminal outcome check. Q2 is a separately specified relation/invariant check over a paired observation. A copied or paraphrased Q1 is rejected as Q2. Promotion requires both views to pass after durable readback; disagreement remains unresolved.

G1.evidence: Q1 alone cannot promote E or award credit.

G2.evidence: Q2 uses a relation/invariant view; copied/paraphrased Q1 is rejected as non-diverse.

G3.evidence: Q1 PASS / Q2 FAIL rejects E.

G4.evidence: Disagreement becomes explicit CHECKER_DISAGREEMENT, not a synthetic average PASS.

G5.evidence: Transport failure yields UNKNOWN, not semantic success.

G6.evidence: F requires both same-scope terminal checks to pass.

G7.evidence: Promotion is conditional on durable readback of both checker artifacts.

G8.evidence: Scope mismatch, duplicates, and nonterminal evidence are excluded by the precommitted checker contract.

G9.evidence: Successful promotion advances generation; prior-generation completions are stale.

G10.evidence: All-disagree control remains unresolved with nonempty frontier and zero credit.

G11.evidence: This terminal artifact must be independently fetched before role-local credit.

G12.evidence: Accepted path is recurring Chat reasoning plus lightweight repository transport only; no richer/protected/manual execution, finite optional monthly/trial/paid quota, or incremental monetary cost.

scope_limit: Constructed two-view controller trace only. Two checks do not establish statistical independence or eliminate common-mode faults; the cited multiversion literature explicitly cautions against assuming independence.
unresolved_child: Residual checker correlation remains possible even when checkers look different. A later leaf should test correlation-aware disagreement handling or evidence diversification without assuming independence.

quota_cost_assessment.repository_transport_note: Repository API remains lightweight state/evidence transport only; rate-limit interruption is checkpoint/retryable.
